(()=>{const out={};for(const tr of [14,15]){PT8.launch({mode:'mp',track:tr,laps:1,humans:[{id:'merc',alt:0}],ai:[],rally:true,circuit:true});const c=RACE.cars[0];c.forceAI=1;c.ai={skill:1,lat:0,name:'T'};const T=RACE.T,N=T.N;const Y=[],PX=[],CY=[],I=[],G=[];for(let i=0;i<60*110;i++){step(1/60);if(RACE.state==='count')RACE.state='race';if(RACE.state!=='race')continue;if((c.lapT||[]).length>=1)break;const g=c.m.g;Y.push(c.m.visualModel?c.m.visualModel.position.y*g.scale.y:0);PX.push(g.rotation.x);CY.push(c.camY||0);I.push(c.idx);G.push(c.m.wheels.filter(w=>w.g).length)}const n=Y.length,bins={};for(let k=2;k<n;k++){const j=Math.abs(Y[k]-2*Y[k-1]+Y[k-2]),p=Math.abs(PX[k]-2*PX[k-1]+PX[k-2]),cj=Math.abs(CY[k]-2*CY[k-1]+CY[k-2]);const b=Math.floor(I[k]*T.sp/50);const o=bins[b]||(bins[b]={j:0,p:0,c:0,n:0,g:0,sl:0});o.j+=j;o.p+=p;o.c+=cj;o.n++;o.g+=G[k]<4?1:0;const a=I[k],bb=(a+3)%N;o.sl+=(T.y[bb]-T.y[a])/(3*T.sp)}const arr=Object.entries(bins).map(([b,o])=>[+b*50,+(o.j/o.n*1000).toFixed(2),+(o.p/o.n*1000).toFixed(2),+(o.c/o.n*1000).toFixed(2),o.g,+(o.sl/o.n*100).toFixed(1)]).sort((a,b)=>b[2]-a[2]);out[tr]={n,top:arr.slice(0,10),med:arr[arr.length>>1]};PT8.cleanupRace()}return JSON.stringify(out)})()
